title: Scheduled recheck, 11 Oct 2026 14:44 (weekly pass 2026-W41)
scope: Weekly backstop for 2026-W41 (the only queued item), against the live bundles published 2026-10-11T19:29:01+00:00 (tool 2.53.1; collection of 2026-10-11 08:09-08:11 UTC). Every inactive plan on any rank (7) was checked. No Gold+ grade was rechecked: the Gold+ reference bundle has no Pred.gg statistics (scoped_statistics failed), so all 86 reviewed grades show "Review covers a different cohort" and none is withheld for moved statistics. Not a full review.
standard: docs/RECHECK-RUNNER.md with the 2.34 / 27 Sep grade standard: a grade moves one step at most, a move needs a kit or patch reason plus evidence the same way, a drop without a kit reason needs the whole-line 95% interval to exclude the previous-patch review rate, and a high rate alone never raises a grade. Without the reference sample no grade can be judged, so none is touched.
